## Blog posts

- [Entity SEO vs Keyword SEO: What Changes and What Stays](https://dilbdrbk.com.np/blog/entity-seo-vs-keyword-seo/): Entity SEO vs keyword SEO: keywords show how people search, entities show what they mean. See the differences, where each works and how to combine them.
